name: security-antipatterns-javascript
description: Code generation guard for JavaScript/TypeScript/Next.js - prevents OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities while writing code. Covers injection, XSS, authentication, cryptography, and framework-specific security patterns.
author: Subhash Dasyam

skills.name: security-antipatterns-javascript
skills.description: Security anti-patterns guard for JavaScript/TypeScript/Next.js applications

resources.name: injection
resources.description: SQL, Command, NoSQL, Template, LDAP injection patterns (CWE-89, CWE-78)

resources.name: xss-output
resources.description: XSS (Reflected, Stored, DOM) and output encoding (CWE-79)

resources.name: auth-access
resources.description: BOLA, BFLA, authentication, sessions, JWT, NextAuth patterns

resources.name: crypto-secrets
resources.description: Secrets management, encryption, hashing, key derivation

resources.name: input-validation
resources.description: Validation, mass assignment, path traversal, file uploads

resources.name: typescript-safety
resources.description: TypeScript type safety gaps and runtime validation

resources.name: nextjs-security
resources.description: Next.js middleware bypass, Server Actions, RSC, SSRF patterns

resources.name: api-infra
resources.description: Rate limiting, CORS, headers, error handling

resources.name: nodejs-runtime
resources.description: ReDoS, event loop blocking, child processes
